name: Telegram
label: Telegram — Telegram Bot API
description: Telegram via the official Telegram Bot API. Base https://api.telegram.org. Docs: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api. Canonical messaging node; social-media.md is discovery only — same folder nodes/telegram. listen = setWebhook HTTPS or getUpdates, delivered as a BPMN message event. secret_token header for webhook verify. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Telegram operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"send-message"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-message | send-photo | send-document | send-audio | send-video | send-animation | send-sticker | send-location | send-media-group | send-chat-action | edit-message | delete-message | pin-message | unpin-message | get-file | get-chat | get-chat-administrators | get-chat-member | leave-chat | set-chat-title | set-chat-description | answer-callback-query | answer-inline-query | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: chat_id
schema.description: Chat id or @username. Bots cannot DM users who have not started them. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Message text (send-message / edit-message). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: message_id
schema.description: Message id for edit/delete/pin/unpin. Integer as Telegram requires.

schema.label: file_id
schema.description: Telegram file_id for get-file. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: latitude
schema.description: Latitude for send-location. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: longitude
schema.description: Longitude for send-location. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: parse_mode
schema.description: HTML | Markdown | MarkdownV2. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: callback_query_id
schema.description: Callback query id to answer. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: inline_query_id
schema.description: Inline query id to answer. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: reply_to_message_id
schema.description: send-message reply_to_message_id (integer message id).

schema.label: photo
schema.description: Request-body parameter `photo` for operation: send-photo.

schema.label: caption
schema.description: Request-body parameter `caption` for operations: send-photo, send-document, send-audio, send-video, send-animation.

schema.label: document
schema.description: Request-body parameter `document` for operation: send-document.

schema.label: audio
schema.description: Request-body parameter `audio` for operation: send-audio.

schema.label: video
schema.description: Request-body parameter `video` for operation: send-video.

schema.label: animation
schema.description: Request-body parameter `animation` for operation: send-animation.

schema.label: sticker
schema.description: Request-body parameter `sticker` for operation: send-sticker.

schema.label: media
schema.description: JSON array of 2–10 InputMedia objects for send-media-group (required). Each item: {type: photo|video|document|audio, media: file_id or HTTPS URL, caption?}. Example: [{"type":"photo","media":"https://example.com/a.jpg"},{"type":"photo","media":"https://example.com/b.jpg"}].

schema.label: action
schema.description: Chat action for send-chat-action (required). EXACT: typing | upload_photo | record_video | upload_video | record_voice | upload_voice | upload_document | choose_sticker | find_location | record_video_note | upload_video_note. Example: typing.

schema.label: inline_message_id
schema.description: Request-body parameter `inline_message_id` for operation: edit-message.

schema.label: user_id
schema.description: Target user ID for get-chat-member (required). Example: 123456789.

schema.label: title
schema.description: New chat title for set-chat-title (required), 1–128 characters. Example: Release Team.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Request-body parameter `description` for operation: set-chat-description.

schema.label: show_alert
schema.description: answer-callback-query show_alert. true shows a popup instead of a toast.

schema.label: results
schema.description: JSON array of up to 50 InlineQueryResult objects for answer-inline-query (required). Example: [{"type":"article","id":"1","title":"Hi","input_message_content":{"message_text":"Hello"}}].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-message, send-photo, send-document, send-audio, send-video, send-animation, send-sticker, send-location, send-media-group, send-chat-action, edit-message, delete-message, pin-message, unpin-message, get-file, get-chat, get-chat-administrators, get-chat-member, leave-chat, set-chat-title, set-chat-description, answer-callback-query, answer-inline-query, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: bot_token
configurationParameters.description: Bot token from BotFather (123:ABC). Path /bot{bot_token}/…. StudioQuack secret.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
